notes.title: Timpu's treasure is going free!
notes.content:
Hello everyone and happy new year!

After a lot of thought and deliberation I have decided to make all of my games including Timpu's Treasure completely free.

It has been a tough couple of years for all of us, and for me specifically it meant giving up on professional indie-game development. 

However, I love this game and want as many people to enjoy it as possible. With that in mind I think it's best to make this game available for free. I have asked the folks at Valve to make this change on the 15th of February 2022.

Those of you have bought the game, I can't thank you enough for your support! 

Hope you have a great 2022!

Thank you.
Siddharth

notes.title: Timpu's treasure is out!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm really happy to announce that Timpu's treasure is out now! TImpu's treasure is a treasure hunting game set in a colourful little town full of secrets. I can't wait for you to try the game out!

In case you have any problems in the game (or if you're stuck anywhere), feel free to post on the forums for help. There'll be a separate thread just for bugs and other technical problems, please let me know there if you encounter any issues that makes it hard to play the game.

Thanks and happy playing!

- Sid
